name: marketingskills
description: Marketing skills for Claude Code and AI agents. CRO, copywriting, SEO, analytics, and growth engineering.
one_liner: A ready-made pack of marketing know-how — conversion optimization, copywriting, SEO, analytics — that you plug into your AI assistant so it can do a marketer's job, not just a coder's.
buyer: A solo founder or small e-commerce store owner who can't afford a marketing hire but already has an AI coding assistant.
business_use_cases: A solo SaaS founder has their AI agent audit and rewrite landing page copy for conversion instead of hiring a copywriter.
A small e-commerce store owner has their agent run basic SEO audits and keyword research automatically every week.
A marketing freelancer uses it to speed up client audits, delivering CRO and SEO recommendations in hours instead of days.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a done-for-you 'AI marketing audit' service built on these skills, selling short reports to small businesses for a flat fee.

steal_this: This weekend, run the skill pack against five local businesses' websites and sell each a one-page CRO/SEO audit for $50-100.
